player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} ({role}) in a {num_rounds}-round Matching Pennies game.
- Each round, submit [heads] or [tails] (or [h], [t]).
- If your choice matches your opponent’s, Player 0 wins the round; otherwise Player 1 wins.
Reply with your choice in the format '[heads]' or '[tails]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Foma isiyo sahihi; tafadhali wasilisha '[heads]' au '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Mchezaji 0 alichagua {choice0}; Mchezaji 1 alichagua {choice1}. Match -> Mchezaji 0 anashinda
message.round_mismatch: Mchezaji 0 alichagua {choice0}; Mchezaji 1 alichagua {choice1}. Mismatch -> Mchezaji 1 anashinda.

outcome.draw: Gimoro amora ma ne otimore, ne ok oloso kata matin.
